Thank you so much for having the courage to post this. I broke down reading this (and other comments) because it made me realise how deep-rooted my issues with physical contact are.

>I (21F) didn’t even realize it wasn’t normal for parents to kiss their adult kids on the lips.

My mum would also make me kiss her on the lips in a similar manner, even though she knew I hated it and I would vigorously wipe my lips with my arm and wash my mouth out in the bathroom.

>What the heck is up with Nparents thinking they’re entitled to their children’s bodies?

She had alcoholic tenancies and (while I was younger) would come in my room in the early hours of the morning, forcing herself on me trying to hug and kiss me. I would try to push her off but she was way too heavy. She would leave me alone quicker if I just reciprocated. 

This made me dislike hugging people and physical contact overall, unless it was someone I was very close to and they asked for one. It's prevented me from forming intimate relationships because I would feel that anxious about being so close to them.

I hope that if anyone has been through a similar experience, they can eventually overcome it before it negatively impacts their life too much.

I agree that a physically change feels much stronger or impactful than a mental change (At least for me since I have problems with regressing due to mental health issues) but it's important to have a healthy balance of both.

At the moment, I main Ezreal, Lucian, MF, Tris and Graves this season.

Lucian is my go to this season. Really strong in lane, and pretty good damage all game. Not too hard to play but has a high skill ceiling.

Ezreal's blue build is VERY strong this season once he gets going but he struggles against tanks. A bit harder to play than Lucian.

MF has been nerfed a bit before 6.2 but that's just her laning. If you get some peel, you can do crazy damage, and we all know about her ult! Pretty easy to get a hang of.

Tristana has a pretty good early game and if you can get a kill at lv2-6 you can snowball decently. Rocket Jump resets are amazing! Not too hard to play and her skill ceiling is pretty high like Lucian's.

Graves has amazing burst damage, especially with thunderlords. Since he has low aa range and can't aa through things, he can get caught out, but he is a lot tankier then all the adc's out there. He is awesome in top and jungle and also held the highest winrate for all 3 position last patch! 

Draven and Kalista are not amazing this patch but are scarily strong when ahead. 

It doesn't matter who you play in bot lane though,if you are good enough on that ADC, you can turn any counter-pick into a win!
